t: This is the Royal Festival Hall, a concert, dance and talks venue with 2,700 seats, standing on the South Bank of the Thames in Lambeth. It was the first post-war building to be Grade I listed. It was designed by Leslie Martin and Robert Matthew, two leading modernists. Martin was a champion of the International Style, and this is his most famous building. Matthew was a Scottish architect and a leading proponent of modernism. Several orchestras are in residence here, including the London Philharmonic and the Philharmonia.
